biological_question: Does flower-color evolutionary lability predict which phenotypic resolution retains phylogenetic same-state structure across clades?

predictor_extraction.allowed_source: exact clade-level values reported by Sinnott-Armstrong et al. (2026) Appendix S2 or an exact machine-readable companion object traceable to that appendix

analysis_frame.eligible_units: clades with completed exact CHUN resolution profiles and exact source flower-transition counts

directional_claim.rationale: The primary question is whether source-estimated temporal lability has out-of-sample explanatory value for the full two-contrast resolution profile; no post-outcome sign is required for qualification.

manuscript_upgrade_rule: Do not alter the Evolution Letters central claim unless this frozen bridge is executed and its qualification status is recorded.
